db:select.doc:name: Retrieve Existing Contact Onboarding Record
db:select.db:sql: SELECT contact_sf_id FROM contact_onboarding WHERE contact_sf_id = :contact_sf_id

choice.doc:name: Evaluate Existing Contact Onboarding Record Availability

db:update.doc:name: Update Contact Onboarding Record
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE contact_onboarding SET first_name = :first_name, last_name = :last_name, email = :email, phone = :phone, account_id = :account_id, job_title = :job_title, department = :department, reports_to_id = :reports_to_id, account_name = :account_name, account_industry = :account_industry, account_type = :account_type, account_revenue = :account_revenue, account_contact_count = :account_contact_count, contact_priority = :contact_priority, modified_date = :modified_date, updated_at = NOW() WHERE contact_sf_id = :contact_sf_id

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Contact Onboarding Record
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO contact_onboarding ( contact_sf_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, account_id, job_title, department, reports_to_id, account_name, account_industry, account_type, account_revenue, account_contact_count, contact_priority, modified_date, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( :contact_sf_id, :first_name, :last_name, :email, :phone, :account_id, :job_title, :department, :reports_to_id, :account_name, :account_industry, :account_type, :account_revenue, :account_contact_count, :contact_priority, :modified_date, NOW(), NOW() )
